title: Exclusive Beverage Supply Agreement - FizzCo Beverages
content: This Exclusive Beverage Supply Agreement ('Agreement') is entered into as of January 1, 2022, between BigBurger North LLC ('Buyer') and FizzCo Beverages Inc. ('Supplier'). EXCLUSIVITY CLAUSE: Supplier hereby grants Buyer an exclusive right to sell FizzCo branded beverages within the Northern Territory (defined as the states of Washington, Oregon, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, North Dakota, South Dakota, Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan). During the term of this Agreement, Buyer shall not purchase, distribute, or sell any competing carbonated soft drinks from any other supplier without prior written consent. TERM: This agreement shall remain in force from January 1, 2022 through June 30, 2027. MINIMUM PURCHASE OBLIGATION: Buyer agrees to purchase a minimum of 500,000 units per quarter. EARLY TERMINATION PENALTY: In the event of early termination by either party, the terminating party shall pay a penalty of $750,000 USD. LIABILITY CAP: Total aggregated liability under this agreement shall not exceed $2,000,000 USD. RENEWAL: Automatic renewal for 3-year periods unless either party provides 180-day written notice.

title: Beef Supply Agreement - PrimeBeef Farms
content: This Beef Supply Agreement is entered into between BigBurger North LLC and PrimeBeef Farms Co. as of April 1, 2023. SUPPLY TERMS: PrimeBeef Farms agrees to supply 100% USDA certified beef patties in quantities as ordered by Buyer. PRICING: Fixed price of $4.50 per pound for the first year, subject to annual CPI adjustment thereafter. EXCLUSIVITY: This agreement does not contain any exclusivity provisions; Buyer retains the right to source beef from multiple suppliers. TERM: April 1, 2023 through March 15, 2026. RENEWAL: Contract auto-renews for one-year periods unless either party provides 90-day written notice. INSPECTION: Supplier agrees to allow quality inspections at its facilities upon 48-hour notice. LIABILITY: Supplier liability for product defects shall not exceed $500,000 per incident. NOTE: This contract expires March 15, 2026 — renewal action required immediately.

title: Cheese and Dairy Products Agreement - DairySource Co.
content: Cheese and Dairy Products Supply Agreement between BigBurger North LLC and DairySource Co., effective February 1, 2024. PRODUCTS: Supplier provides processed cheese slices, mozzarella, and specialty dairy items in quantities specified by weekly POs from Buyer. DELIVERY: JIT delivery to all North region distribution centers, with 98% on-time delivery commitment. PRICING: $3.20/lb for processed cheese, $2.80/lb for mozzarella, locked for 12 months then subject to quarterly market adjustments. QUALITY STANDARDS: All products must comply with FDA dairy pasteurization and labeling requirements. AUDIT RIGHTS: Buyer may conduct food safety audits at DairySource facilities with 10 business days' notice. TERM: February 1, 2024 through January 31, 2027. LIABILITY: DairySource liability for spoilage or contamination incidents limited to $300,000 per incident. VOLUME REBATE: Buyer receives 2% rebate on annual volumes exceeding 2 million pounds.

title: Food Packaging and Paper Products - PackTech Industries
content: Food Packaging Supply Agreement between BigBurger North LLC and PackTech Industries, effective June 1, 2023. PRODUCTS: Corrugated boxes, paper bags, napkins, food wrappers, and biodegradable containers in quantities per monthly forecasts. PRICING: Tiered pricing based on volumes: 0-100 skids/month at $1,200/skid; 100-200 skids at $1,100/skid; 200+ skids at $1,000/skid. SUSTAINABILITY: Supplier commits to 50% recycled content minimum by end of year 2 of contract. LEAD TIME: 15-day standard lead time for custom orders; 5-day expedite available at 15% premium. TERM: June 1, 2023 through May 31, 2026. MINIMUM ORDER: $50,000 per month minimum commitment. LIABILITY: PackTech liable for defective materials up to $250,000 per shipment.

title: IT Infrastructure and Cloud Services - TechServe Solutions
content: Information Technology Infrastructure and Cloud Services Agreement between BigBurger North LLC and TechServe Solutions Inc., effective January 1, 2023. SERVICES: Cloud hosting on AWS, database management, backup and disaster recovery, security monitoring, and 24/7 technical support. SLA: 99.95% uptime guarantee with automatic service credits for any downtime exceeding SLA. PRICING: $75,000/month base + metered cloud usage on pay-as-you-go basis (average $15,000-$25,000/month). DATA SECURITY: TechServe maintains SOC 2 Type II certification and encrypts all data at rest and in transit. BACKUP: Daily incremental backups and weekly full backups retained for 90 days minimum. TERM: January 1, 2023 through December 31, 2026. TERMINATION: Either party may terminate with 60 days' written notice; early termination fee of 3 months' base service charges applies. LIABILITY CAP: TechServe's total liability limited to 12 months of service fees.

title: Facility Cleaning and Janitorial Services - CleanCorp Services
content: Facility Cleaning and Janitorial Services Agreement between BigBurger North LLC and CleanCorp Services Inc., effective March 1, 2024. SERVICES: Daily cleaning of all North region restaurant locations including floors, restrooms, kitchen areas, and dining spaces. FREQUENCY: 6 days per week (Monday-Saturday), with 2-hour service windows per location per day. STAFFING: Dedicated team of 8-12 cleaning personnel assigned to North region. SUPPLIES: CleanCorp provides all cleaning chemicals, equipment, and supplies; Buyer reimburses consumables on monthly invoices at cost plus 10%. QUALITY STANDARDS: Health department compliant cleaning protocols; monthly health score certifications provided. PRICING: $18,000/month flat rate plus consumables. TERM: March 1, 2024 through February 28, 2025, renewable annually. PERFORMANCE PENALTIES: $500 per missed service day or health inspection failure attributable to CleanCorp. LIABILITY: CleanCorp's liability for property damage limited to $100,000 per incident.

title: Commercial Lease - Seattle Headquarters and Regional Distribution Center
content: Commercial Lease Agreement between Pacific Properties LLC ('Landlord') and BigBurger North LLC ('Tenant'). PREMISES: 4,500 square feet at 123 Main Street, Seattle, WA 98101 (headquarters) and 15,000 square feet at Industrial Park, Building C, Seattle, WA 98134 (distribution center). TERM: June 1, 2020 to May 31, 2030 (10-year term). RENT: Headquarters $15,000/month with 3% annual escalation; Distribution Center $20,000/month with 3% annual escalation. RENEWAL OPTION: Tenant has two 5-year renewal options at market rate (+3% per annum). EARLY TERMINATION: Tenant may terminate with 12-month written notice and payment of 6 months' base rent as penalty ($210,000 at current rate). USE RESTRICTION: Headquarters for administrative use only; Distribution Center for food storage and logistics operations. MAINTENANCE: Landlord maintains structure and exterior; Tenant maintains interior fixtures and HVAC systems.

title: Health and Safety Inspection Schedule 2026 - King County
content: Health and Safety Inspection Compliance Document for BigBurger North LLC. SCHEDULED INSPECTIONS: Routine health inspection is scheduled for May 1, 2026 across all North region locations. LAST INSPECTION: November 15, 2025 — Score: 97 out of 100. Minor violations: 0. COMPLIANCE STATUS: All North region locations are currently fully compliant with Washington State Food Safety Code Chapter 246-215 WAC. CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: No outstanding corrective actions required as of January 2026. PERMIT RENEWAL: Food service operating permit expires December 31, 2026 — renewal application must be submitted to King County Public Health no later than October 1, 2026 to avoid lapse. CERTIFICATION: Food handler certifications for all staff expire December 31, 2026 and must be renewed before that date.

title: Exclusive Beverage Supply Agreement - FizzCo Beverages
content: This Exclusive Beverage Supply Agreement is entered into as of July 1, 2021, between BigBurger South LLC and FizzCo Beverages Inc. EXCLUSIVITY CLAUSE: FizzCo Beverages Inc. grants BigBurger South LLC an exclusive right to sell and distribute FizzCo branded products within the Southern Territory (Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, Georgia, Florida, South Carolina, North Carolina, Tennessee, Arkansas). During the term of this Agreement, Buyer shall not purchase, stock, or sell any competing carbonated soft drink products from any third-party supplier. ANTI-SUBSTITUTION: No FizzCo product may be substituted with a competing beverage brand. TERM: July 1, 2021 through December 31, 2026. MINIMUM PURCHASE: 600,000 units per quarter minimum commitment. EARLY TERMINATION PENALTY: $850,000 USD if contract is terminated before the expiry date by either party without cause. RENEWAL: Automatic renewal for 3 years unless either party provides 180-day written notice prior to expiry. GOVERNING LAW: State of Texas.

title: Beef and Protein Supply Agreement - SouthernMeat Co.
content: Supply agreement between BigBurger South LLC and SouthernMeat Co. for premium beef patties and chicken products. SUPPLY TERMS: SouthernMeat agrees to maintain a 99% fill rate on all purchase orders. PRICING: Beef patties at $4.20/lb, chicken tenders at $3.80/lb, locked for 2 years then subject to annual market-rate adjustment. VOLUME COMMITMENT: Minimum combined volume of 200,000 lbs per month across all South region locations. FOOD SAFETY: All products must meet current USDA and FDA standards; Supplier maintains active HACCP certification. EXCLUSIVITY: This agreement is non-exclusive. TERM: January 1, 2024 through December 31, 2027. PERFORMANCE PENALTY: $200,000 per quarter if fill rate falls below 95% for any rolling 90-day period. LIABILITY CAP: Aggregate supplier liability capped at $1,000,000.

title: Tortillas and Bread Products - FreshBake Mills
content: Tortillas and Bread Products Supply Agreement between BigBurger South LLC and FreshBake Mills Inc., effective August 1, 2023. PRODUCTS: Fresh flour tortillas, corn tortillas, burger buns, and specialty breads delivered daily to all South region distribution points. DELIVERY: 5 days per week, Monday through Friday, with 24-hour shelf-life guarantee on all products. FRESHNESS GUARANTEE: Products manufactured within 24 hours of delivery; any products reaching distribution centers stale are replaced at no cost. PRICING: Flour tortillas $0.45 per unit; Corn tortillas $0.35 per unit; Burger buns $0.50 per unit; Specialty breads variable based on type. VOLUME COMMITMENT: Minimum 200,000 units per month across all categories. TERM: August 1, 2023 through July 31, 2026. RENEWAL: Auto-renews for 2-year periods unless 90-day notice provided. LIABILITY: FreshBake Mills' liability for quality issues limited to product replacement value plus $150,000 maximum per incident.

title: General Liability and Property Insurance - SafeGuard Insurance Group
content: General Liability and Property Insurance Agreement between BigBurger South LLC and SafeGuard Insurance Group, effective January 1, 2025. COVERAGE: $5,000,000 general liability per location, $2,000,000 products liability, $1,000,000 property damage per occurrence with $15,000,000 aggregate annual limit. PROPERTIES COVERED: All 12 South region restaurant locations plus distribution center. DEDUCTIBLE: $50,000 per claim; $100,000 annual aggregate deductible. PREMIUM: $325,000 per year payable quarterly; includes loss history review and premium adjustment annually. COVERAGE EXCLUSIONS: Intentional acts, war, nuclear hazards, and cyber liability excluded. ADDITIONAL INSURED: Corporate parent company (BigBurger Inc.) named as additional insured. TERM: January 1, 2025 through December 31, 2027. CANCELLATION: Either party may cancel with 30 days' written notice; non-renewal notice required 60 days prior to expiry. CLAIMS PROCEDURE: All claims must be reported within 30 days of incident occurrence.

title: Master Lease Agreement - Texas Portfolio (12 Locations)
landlord: Lone Star Commercial Real Estate Holdings
content: Master Commercial Lease Agreement covering 12 BigBurger South LLC restaurant locations across Texas. TERM: March 1, 2019 to February 28, 2028. AGGREGATE MONTHLY RENT: $148,000 across all 12 locations combined. RENT ESCALATION: 2.5% annually on each lease anniversary. EARLY TERMINATION: Individual locations may be terminated with 9-month written notice plus an early termination payment of 3 months' rent per location ($37,000 per location at average current rent). CROSS-DEFAULT PROVISION: Default on any single individual location lease constitutes a cross-default event applicable to all 12 locations. RENEWAL OPTIONS: Each location holds an independent 5-year renewal option exercisable 6 months before lease expiry. ASSIGNMENT: All leases are assignable to direct corporate affiliates without landlord consent.

title: Health and Safety Inspection - Texas Quarterly Compliance Report
issuer: Texas Department of State Health Services
content: Quarterly compliance report for BigBurger South LLC Texas locations. NEXT SCHEDULED INSPECTION: April 15, 2026 at the Dallas flagship location. RECENT VIOLATIONS: Minor temperature logging violation at Houston location identified January 2026 — corrective action was completed February 1, 2026. OVERALL COMPLIANCE SCORE: 94 out of 100. OUTSTANDING ITEMS: Commercial hood cleaning certification renewal is due March 31, 2026 — action required. FOOD HANDLER CERTIFICATIONS: All staff food handler certifications are current through December 2026 with no lapses.

title: Exclusive Beverage Supply Agreement - BubbleDrink Corp
content: This Exclusive Beverage Supply Agreement is entered into as of January 1, 2023, between BigBurger East LLC and BubbleDrink Corp. EXCLUSIVITY CLAUSE: BigBurger East LLC agrees to purchase all carbonated soft drink, juice, and bottled water products exclusively from BubbleDrink Corp for all Eastern Territory locations (New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, New Hampshire, Vermont, Maine). COMPETITOR PROHIBITION: Buyer expressly agrees it shall not purchase, stock, sell, or display any products manufactured or distributed by FizzCo Beverages Inc. or any of its affiliates at any Eastern Territory location during the contract term. This prohibition applies to all FizzCo branded carbonated beverages, juices, and water products. ANTI-COMPETE SCOPE: This exclusivity explicitly and directly prohibits FizzCo Beverages products, which creates a direct conflict with any national FizzCo supply arrangement. TERM: January 1, 2023 through September 30, 2027. MINIMUM PURCHASE: 450,000 units per quarter. EARLY TERMINATION PENALTY: $1,200,000 USD if contract is terminated before expiry by either party without cause. RENEWAL: Automatic 2-year renewal unless 180-day notice provided. GOVERNING LAW: State of New York.

title: Beef and Poultry Supply - Northeast Provisions Inc.
content: Beef and Poultry Supply Agreement between BigBurger East LLC and Northeast Provisions Inc., effective June 1, 2022. PRODUCTS: USDA Prime and Choice beef patties, chicken breasts, and ground turkey for regional distribution. PRICING: Beef $4.75/lb, Chicken $3.95/lb, Turkey $3.50/lb, with annual market adjustment after first year. DELIVERY: 3 deliveries per week to central distribution facility in New Jersey with 99% on-time delivery guarantee. QUALITY ASSURANCE: All products tested for pathogenic bacteria; annual food safety audits by third-party inspectors. VOLUME: Minimum 150,000 lbs per month with seasonal variance permitted (±20% per month). TERM: June 1, 2022 through May 31, 2026. EARLY TERMINATION: Either party may terminate with 90 days' notice; early termination fee of $400,000 applies to buyer-initiated termination. LIABILITY: Northeast Provisions liable for product contamination up to $600,000 per incident; buyer liable for volume shortfalls up to $200,000 per quarter.

title: Fresh Produce Supply - Valley Fresh Farms
content: Fresh Produce Supply Agreement between BigBurger East LLC and Valley Fresh Farms, effective April 1, 2024. PRODUCTS: Fresh lettuce, tomatoes, onions, pickles, and specialty vegetables for all East region restaurants. DELIVERY FREQUENCY: 4-5 days per week for lettuce and tomatoes; twice weekly for other vegetables. SEASONAL SOURCING: Summer sourcing from local NY/NJ farms; winter sourcing from California and Florida suppliers. FRESHNESS GUARANTEE: All produce must be delivered within 2 days of harvest with minimum shelf life of 5 days. PRICING: Market-based with weekly price updates reflecting commodity prices; quarterly price floors and ceilings negotiated. VOLUME: 75,000-100,000 lbs per week depending on season. QUALITY STANDARDS: USDA Grade A minimum; rejected shipments replaced within 24 hours at no charge. TERM: April 1, 2024 through March 31, 2027. LIABILITY: Valley Fresh liable for spoilage or contamination up to $175,000 per shipment.

title: Third-Party Logistics and Distribution - TransLogix Services
content: Third-Party Logistics and Distribution Services Agreement between BigBurger East LLC and TransLogix Services Inc., effective September 1, 2023. SERVICES: Warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment, and last-mile delivery to all East region restaurant locations. WAREHOUSE: 50,000 sq ft climate-controlled warehouse in central New Jersey. INVENTORY MANAGEMENT: Real-time inventory tracking via EDI/API integration; monthly inventory reconciliation. DELIVERY: Same-day delivery for orders placed before 2 PM; next-day delivery for later orders. PRICING: $8,500/month warehouse fee plus $0.50 per case for outbound delivery. TEMPERATURE CONTROL: Refrigerated and frozen sections maintained at required temperatures; daily temperature logs. SLA: 99% order fulfillment accuracy; performance bonus/penalty clauses apply. TERM: September 1, 2023 through August 31, 2026. TERMINATION: Either party may terminate with 90 days' notice. LIABILITY: TransLogix liable for lost/damaged shipments up to invoice value plus $500,000 per incident maximum.

title: Commercial Leases - Northeast Region Restaurant Locations (8 Sites)
content: Master Lease Agreement for 8 BigBurger East LLC restaurant locations across the Northeast Region (NYC, Boston, Philadelphia, Washington DC areas). PREMISES: Total 22,500 sq ft across 8 locations averaging 2,800 sq ft per location. TERM: January 1, 2021 to December 31, 2031 (11-year term). BASE RENT: $275,000 annually ($22,917/month) plus common area maintenance (CAM) charges averaging $3,500/month. ESCALATION: 2% annual rent increase on each lease anniversary. EARLY TERMINATION: Tenant may terminate individual locations with 12-month written notice and payment of 9 months' base rent per location ($137,500/location). RENEWAL OPTIONS: Two 5-year renewal options available at fair market value. USE: Permitted use is quick-service restaurant and associated administrative offices. TENANT IMPROVEMENTS: Landlord provided $150,000 upfront for initial tenant improvements; any additional improvements are Tenant's responsibility.

title: Health Department Compliance and Food Service License Status - Northeast Region
content: Health Department Compliance Report for BigBurger East LLC, covering all Northeast region restaurant locations. CURRENT STATUS: All 8 locations currently hold valid food service licenses with no active violations or outstanding compliance orders. LAST INSPECTIONS: Conducted between December 2025 and January 2026 with average inspection scores of 96.5 out of 100. UPCOMING INSPECTIONS: Routine inspections scheduled for June 2026 at NYC and Boston locations; September 2026 at other locations. FOOD HANDLER CERTIFICATIONS: 100% of food handling staff current on certifications through December 2026. OUTSTANDING ITEMS: New York City mandates allergen training certification for all staff by March 31, 2026 — training program scheduled for March 2026. LICENSE RENEWALS: All food service licenses expire January 31, 2027 and renewal applications must be submitted 60 days prior (by November 30, 2026).

title: Beverage Supply Agreement - Mountain Springs Beverages
content: Beverage Supply Agreement between BigBurger West LLC and Mountain Springs Beverages Co., effective January 1, 2024. PRODUCTS: Carbonated soft drinks, bottled water, sports drinks, and energy beverages for all West region locations. SUPPLY TERMS: Non-exclusive supplier arrangement; Buyer may source from multiple beverage suppliers within the Western Territory. PRICING: $2.10/case for carbonated beverages, $1.80/case for bottled water, $2.75/case for specialty drinks. VOLUME COMMITMENT: Minimum 300,000 cases per quarter; volume rebates available: 2% for volumes exceeding 1.5M cases annually. DELIVERY: Bi-weekly delivery to all West region distribution points with 95% on-time guarantee. TERM: January 1, 2024 through December 31, 2027. MARKETING SUPPORT: Mountain Springs provides quarterly marketing materials and promotional displays at no cost. LIABILITY: Mountain Springs liable for defective products up to $225,000 per incident; replacement guarantee within 48 hours.

title: Prime Beef Supply Agreement - Great Plains Cattle Co.
content: Prime Beef Supply Agreement between BigBurger West LLC and Great Plains Cattle Co., effective July 1, 2023. PRODUCTS: Premium USDA Prime grade beef patties, ground beef, and steak cuts for premium menu items. PRICING: $5.25/lb for Prime patties, $4.85/lb for ground beef, locked pricing for 24 months. SOURCING: 100% beef sourced from cattle raised in Colorado, Wyoming, and Montana using sustainable ranching practices. CERTIFICATION: All beef carries Certified Angus Beef (CAB) certification. VOLUME: Minimum 80,000 lbs per month with allowance for ±15% monthly variance. QUALITY ASSURANCE: Annual on-farm audits; microbiological testing of all shipments. SUSTAINABILITY: Great Plains commits to carbon-neutral operations by end of 2025. TERM: July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2026. RENEWAL: Auto-renews for 3-year periods unless 120-day notice provided. LIABILITY: Great Plains liable for quality issues up to $350,000 per incident.

title: Condiments and Sauces - Flavor Masters Inc.
content: Condiments and Sauces Supply Agreement between BigBurger West LLC and Flavor Masters Inc., effective May 1, 2024. PRODUCTS: Ketchup, mustard, mayonnaise, specialty sauces, and condiment packets in bulk and individual packaging. MANUFACTURING: All products manufactured in Flavor Masters facilities in California using locally sourced ingredients where possible. CUSTOMIZATION: West region exclusive recipes and flavors developed by Flavor Masters R&D team; minimum 2-year exclusivity on custom formulations. PRICING: Tiered by product and volume; ketchup $18/case (12 units), sauces $22/case, specialty items variable. VOLUME COMMITMENT: Minimum 50,000 cases per month across all products. SHELF LIFE: Guaranteed 18-month shelf life from manufacturing date. TERM: May 1, 2024 through April 30, 2027. QUALITY ASSURANCE: HACCP certified; third-party lab testing on all batches for allergen and contaminant testing. LIABILITY: Flavor Masters liable for defective products up to $125,000 per incident.

title: Utilities and Energy Management - WestPower Energy Solutions
content: Utilities and Energy Management Agreement between BigBurger West LLC and WestPower Energy Solutions, effective October 1, 2023. SERVICES: Electricity procurement, natural gas procurement, and energy efficiency consulting for all West region locations. RENEWABLE ENERGY: 50% of electricity sourced from renewable energy sources (wind, solar) with commitment to increase to 75% by 2027. ENERGY AUDITS: Annual energy audits and efficiency recommendations; WestPower provides no-cost LED lighting upgrades across all locations. PROCUREMENT: WestPower negotiates fixed-rate electricity contracts with local utilities; natural gas at variable rates tied to Henry Hub index plus 5% markup. PRICING: Annual service fee $12,000 plus utility pass-through costs; 3% volume discount on annual consumption exceeding 5,000 MWh. TERM: October 1, 2023 through September 30, 2028. SUSTAINABILITY GOALS: Joint commitment to reduce energy consumption by 20% over contract term. LIABILITY: WestPower liable for service interruptions exceeding 4 hours; $1,000 per incident credit to Buyer.

title: Commercial Lease Portfolio - Western US Region (15 Locations)
content: Master Commercial Lease Agreement covering 15 BigBurger West LLC restaurant locations across the Western US (California, Nevada, Arizona, Utah, Colorado). PREMISES: Total 35,000 sq ft across 15 locations ranging from 2,000-2,800 sq ft each. TERM: June 1, 2018 to May 31, 2028 (10-year term). BASE RENT: $420,000 annually ($35,000/month) plus CAM charges estimated at $5,200/month. ESCALATION: 3% annual rent increases on each lease anniversary. EARLY TERMINATION: Tenant may terminate with 15-month notice and payment of 6 months' base rent per location as penalty ($105,000 per location). RENEWAL OPTIONS: Two 5-year renewal options at fair market value, with rent increases capped at 4% per annum. USE RESTRICTIONS: Exclusive use as quick-service restaurant with ancillary retail permitted. LANDLORD RESPONSIBILITIES: Landlord maintains roof, structural elements, exterior walls, parking lot; Tenant maintains interior and all operating systems.

title: National Beverage Supply Framework - FizzCo Beverages Strategic Partnership
content: National Strategic Beverage Supply Framework Agreement between BigBurger Inc. (parent company) and FizzCo Beverages Inc., effective January 1, 2025. PURPOSE: This framework agreement establishes a corporate-level strategic partnership for FizzCo products across all BigBurger subsidiaries nationwide. NATIONAL SCOPE: Intends to coordinate FizzCo product availability, pricing, and marketing across all four regional subsidiaries (North, South, East, West). PRICING: Corporate volume discounts apply if aggregate purchases across all subsidiaries exceed 2.5M units per quarter ($0.95/unit; otherwise $1.05/unit). CONFLICT RESOLUTION: This corporate-level agreement should supersede regional exclusivity agreements where conflicts arise; regional agreements requiring amendment for national alignment. MARKETING: Joint national marketing campaign featuring FizzCo brands; cost-sharing proportional to regional volumes. TERM: January 1, 2025 through December 31, 2028. REVIEW FREQUENCY: Quarterly business reviews with senior leadership from corporate and FizzCo to address regional conflicts and optimize supply chain. ESCALATION: Any regional conflicts regarding FizzCo products must be escalated to VP of Supply Chain within 30 days. NOTE: Regional subsidiary exclusivity agreements with competing suppliers create conflict with this framework and require legal review.
